# VNMSFX

> Rapid response ops for food & beverage (CPG) brands, New York. VNMSFX builds the AI-native system that catches what slipped — a wholesale account gone quiet, a distributor deduction deadline closing, a Meta ad buying clicks for a sold-out flavor, a paid subscription with no matching shipment — and puts it, with the evidence, in front of the right person. Run your business like you have an ops team, without hiring one: a small team operates like a funded one, without the ops payroll or the dilution. Wired to the tools the brand already uses (Shopify, QuickBooks, Notion, Claude, Gmail). Built once, owned by the client. Founder: Brandon Adams.

## Engagements
- Free teardown (30 min): a working session about one place where important follow-through may be breaking and whether the Audit fits. Book: https://cal.com/vnmsfx/30min
- The Leak Audit ($2,500): three written questions in one agreed area; delivered within five business days of Audit Ready; evidence-backed answers, a Build Map and a 60-minute walkthrough. The Audit includes no implementation. Sample format (fictional company): https://vnmsfx.com/sample-audit
- No-finding promise: if the completed Audit tests all three questions and documents zero qualifying operating issues under the written rules agreed before payment, VNMSFX refunds the full $2,500 and the client keeps the completed report. Missing records never become a finding.
- The standard Build ($5,000/mo x 3): three tested Working Checks using up to four agreed sources across the full engagement. The first is live within 10 business days of Build Ready, all three are live by the end of week eight, and month three covers reliability, training and handover. Thirty days of defect support are included.
- The standard Build is sold only when the Audit identifies three build-ready checks. If it identifies only one or two, the client keeps the completed Audit and VNMSFX stops there rather than inventing another problem.
- Payment schedule, Audit through handover: Audit $2,500, Build month one $2,500 after the Audit credit, month two $5,000, month three $5,000. Total: $15,000, not $17,500. The credit applies only to a paid, non-refunded Audit when the Build agreement and first Build payment are completed within 60 calendar days of Audit delivery.
- Outside costs: approved software, AI, API, automation and hosting are paid directly by the client and sit outside the $15,000. The signed Build scope lists exact products, existing versus new costs, expected monthly range, usage assumptions and spending limits before Build Ready.
- Audit versus Build: the Audit is a five-business-day snapshot that tests three questions and changes nothing. The Build creates three running checks. Standard scope shows the evidence and proposed next step to the named person; the client decides and takes the external action.
- Launch price: $15,000 applies to the first two complete VNMSFX Builds. Pricing will be reviewed after those Builds are documented.

## Terms
The client's existing systems remain the official records. The working project and outputs live in a restricted client-owned workspace. Access uses a named collaborator, client-owned service identity, approved OAuth connection or client-created export — never a shared password. Standard workflows read agreed records; approved outputs are written only to named client-owned destinations. Any broader technical permission is disclosed and approved, or recurring exports are used. The exact client-owned AI product, mode, account owner, model, tools and retention settings are named in the data schedule before access. AI output must tie to source evidence and repeatable non-AI checks before a named reviewer can approve it. Standard scope does not change books, orders, inventory or payments and does not send messages. Security: https://vnmsfx.com/security. Terms: https://vnmsfx.com/terms
